description: React component for a modal dialog to configure channel notification preferences in Mattermost, including desktop and mobile notifications, mute/ignore options, and thread follow settings.

methods.name: getStateFromNotifyProps
methods.description: Initializes notification settings state from user and channel notify props.

methods.name: getInitialValuesOfChannelNotifyProps
methods.description: Determines initial notification property value based on defaults, channel, and user notify props.

methods.name: getInitialValuesOfIgnoreChannelMentions
methods.description: Calculates initial ignore mentions setting based on current notification levels and user preferences.

methods.name: createChannelNotifyPropsFromSelectedSettings
methods.description: Generates channel notify props object from user selections, considering desktop/mobile sync and defaults.

methods.name: areDesktopAndMobileSettingsDifferent
methods.description: Checks if desktop and mobile notification settings differ, considering thread collapse setting.
